agents_directives.description: Plugin v0.6.0 ships as kb-first Stage 1 of v0.3.0 sibling ecosystem. Uses cross-process-lock-recipe for multi-process deployments. Stderr-tee discipline required by consumers. Config resolves in 4 layers: defaults -> user JSON -> project JSON -> env. Required env: AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR. Env-only secrets: AGENT_KB_EMBED_API_KEY, AGENT_KB_PINECONE_API_KEY.

Stage 1 of 4 — SQL-injection AST validator was highest-severity blocking item (shipped). Completed: where-clause validator, read-only sqlite, 50-row batch hard-reject, safe-where-clause-grammar docs, cross-process-lock recipe, kb_pipeline_status telemetry. Incomplete: dedup_key/dedup_policy as first-class, kb_list_pages/sources augmentation, per-kb_id asyncio.Lock, per-page embedding model tracking.
MCP server invocation currently hardcoded to 'uv run --directory ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} python -m agent_knowledgebase.server'. REMOVING uv is explicit requirement.

0.7.0 swapped third-party openai SDK for plain httpx embeddings client. 0.6.0 added structured stderr telemetry + 9 new pipeline_runs columns. Current version 0.6.0 per pyproject.toml but changelog shows 0.7.0 work completed.

Verification required before claiming completion: type-check, lint, test suite. Never silently narrow scope to changed files only. Parallel subagents preferred for refactors > 5 files. Branch-and-PR workflow.

broken_modules_identified.reason: User report: 'current embeddings do not work'. Module was rewritten in 0.7.0 to use plain httpx (removed openai SDK). Likely issues: local sentence-transformers path may still reference removed code, remote provider config validation may reject valid URLs, error surfacing may hide real failures behind EmbedderUnavailableError.

User report: 'kb tool methods do not work'. The 180s wall-clock timeout in server.py swallows stalls, and sqlite3 thread-affinity bug forces service-rebuild on every timeout. Query hybrid-weights validation may be rejecting valid defaults.

python_dep_surface_bytes_estimated: ~2GB mostly from sentence-transformers/torch+transformers+tokenizers; chromadb adds ~400MB; tree-sitter-languages adds ~100MB
